description: Astronomy and Space: from a small body, exoplanet, launch or date to what the responsible bodies published and when - MPC designations and identifications, MPC and JPL orbit solution vintages, quoted Sentry listings, NASA Exoplanet Archive dispositions per table, GCAT and CelesTrak launches and objects and NOAA SWPC alerts - each with source, revision and as-of time and linked to Science papers by bibcode or DOI. Noesis determines no orbit and issues no risk verdict.

profiles.description: Published-record vocabulary: solutions, dispositions and alerts are quoted

vocabulary.solution: an orbit solution as one publisher states it (a vintage)
vocabulary.disposition: the archive's status of a planet or candidate per table
vocabulary.identification: designations the MPC states are one object

optional_features.description: NOAA SWPC alerts, watches and warnings kept as an issued history

requires.reason: the bundle's own entry points use these operations

exclusions: orbit determination, propagation-based prediction, close-approach computation or conjunction screening
impact-risk, hazard or collision verdicts (only published Sentry listings are quoted with their date)
exoplanet validation or disposition by Noesis (the archive's disposition is quoted)
classified, export-controlled or account-restricted catalogue data (Space-Track is not implemented)
operational space-weather advice (alerts are quoted as issued)
never: compute a close approach or conjunction
average or merge values from different solutions

query_examples.intent: Which designations and identifications did the MPC publish for this small body by a date
query_examples.semantics: cited designations and identifications at the cutoff; not_yet_published before the first publication

query_examples.intent: Which orbit solution had JPL published by a date
query_examples.semantics: the latest published solution with epoch, arc, observation count and solution ID; other publishers listed separately, never averaged

query_examples.intent: What was this planet's or candidate's status on a date
query_examples.semantics: the archive's disposition per table with its reference; later changes shown as later

query_examples.intent: Which launches did this provider fly and how did they end
query_examples.semantics: outcomes as coded by GCAT with payloads; sites resolved only through review

query_examples.intent: Which space-weather alerts were issued in this window
query_examples.semantics: SWPC messages verbatim, cancellations and extensions threaded; no advice
